theme: tournament referee who has seen every match beforehand
title: The Foresighted Referee
strategies: trivial: blind re-searched binary-insertion certificate over the whole roster (checker's own baseline construction)

greedy: replay a textbook live binary min-heap (array-based, real sift-up/sift-down) and log every comparison it performs -- the obvious 'priority queue = heap' translation, oblivious to full-script foreknowledge

strong: exploit full foreknowledge -- for each new registrant, find its two immediate rating-neighbors among everyone registered so far (a free internal lookup) and file only the 1-2 comparisons that link it to them; transitivity (proven: any correct comparison-based sort's filed comparisons must transitively recover the whole order) certifies every future cut for free, with cuts costing zero additional comparisons
invalid: files the (checker-computed) correct cut identities but with zero comparisons -- correct answers with no certificate, must score 0
